sections.text_helper: Section 23.8.3 "Comparator configuration register 1 (COMP_CFGR1)" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 721.
sections.section_content:
The COMP_CFGR1 is the COMP1 configuration register.
Address offset: 0x0C
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bit 31 LOCK: Lock
This bit is set by software and cleared by a hardware system reset. It locks the whole content
of the COMP channel configuration register COMP_CFGR1[31:0]
0: COMP_CFGR1[31:0] register is read/write
1: COMP_CFGR1[31:0] is read-only
Bits 30:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:24 BLANKING[3:0]: COMP1 channel blanking source selection
Bits of this field are set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set).
The field selects the input source for COMP1 channel output blanking.
Note: See Table173: COMP blanking source assignment for more details.
Bit 23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:20 INPSEL[2:0]: COMP1 non-inverting input selection
These bits are set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set).
They select which input is connected to the non-inverting input of COMP1 channel.
Note: See Table167: COMP implementation non-inverting input assignment for
STM32C55x/562 and STM32C59x/5A3 and Table169: COMP implementation non-
inverting input assignment for STM32C53x/542 for more details.
Bits 19:16 INMSEL[3:0]: COMP1 channel inverting input selection
These bits are set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). They select which input is
connected to the inverting input of COMP1 channel.
Note: See Table172: COMP inverting input assignment for more details.
Bit 15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 14 WINOUT: COMP1 output selector
This bit is controlled by software (if not locked). It selects the COMP1 output.
0: COMP1_VALUE
1: COMP1_VALUE XOR COMP2_VALUE (required for window mode, see Figure152:
Window comparators functional block diagram
Bits 13:12 PWRMODE[1:0]: Power mode of the COMP1 channel
These bits are set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). They control the
power/speed of the COMP channel.
00: High speed/high power
01: Medium speed/medium power
All others values: Reserved
Bits 11:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 9:8 HYST[1:0]: COMP channel hysteresis selection
These bits are set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). They select the hysteresis
voltage of the COMP channel.
00: No hysteresis
01: Low hysteresis
10: Medium hysteresis
11: High hysteresis
Bit 7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 6 ITEN: COMP channel interrupt enable
This bit is set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). This bit enable the interrupt
generation of the COMP channel.
0: Interrupt generation disabled for COMP channel
1: Interrupt generation enabled for COMP channel
Bit 5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 WINMODE: COMP1 non-inverting input selector for window mode
This bit is controlled by software (if not locked). It selects the COMP1_INP input of COMP1.
0: Signal selected with INPSEL[1:0]
1: COMP2_INP signal of COMP2 (required for window mode, see Figure152: Window
comparators functional block diagram
Bit 3 POLARITY: COMP channel polarity selection
This bit is set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). It inverts COMP channel
polarity.
0: COMP channel output is not inverted
1: COMP channel output is inverted
Bit 2 SCALEN: Voltage scaler enable
This bit is set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). This bit enables the VREFINT
scaler for the COMP channels.
0: VREFINT scaler disabled
1: VREFINT scaler enabled
Bit 1 BRGEN: Scaler bridge enable
This bit is set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). This bit enables the bridge of
the scaler.
0: Scaler resistor bridge disabled
1: Scaler resistor bridge enabled
Bit 0 EN: COMP channel enable
This bit is set and cleared by software (only if LOCK not set). It enables the COMPchannel.
0: Disable
1: Enable
